stations.instrument: Apostolic constitution Si quid est in rebus humanis
stations.title: Urban VIII issues the further emended Missal

cited.basis:
The Code renames the Introit, and both sides of the rename are in the same
scanned book. The Code itself, printed in the witness's front matter, heads its
own section `De antiphona ad Introitum, et Kyrie, eleison` and says at n. 427
`Ad Introitum dicitur antiphona cum versu psalmi et Gloria Patri`
(benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 4633-4637). The Palm Sunday Mass in the same book
then heads the unit `3. Antiphona ad Introitum` with the citation `Ps. 21, 20 et
22` (35155-35157), where the later composite's pre-reform body heads the same
unit `Introitus. Ps. 21, 20 et 22.`
(missale-romanum-later-composite-pre-1955-body 32689). This comparison
establishes the heading change across the two witness bodies, not exact
correspondence between the composite and the 1920 typical edition.
